prompt: Create an original 180 second pastoral acoustic instrumental composition for mystery, nocturnal exploration and restrained suspense. Mood: mysterious, tense, nocturnal. Instruments: concert harp, flute, viola. Style: rolling harp figures and long woodwind answers. Tempo approximately 62 BPM; G minor. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Use unresolved suspended harmony, careful space and subtle low-register movement; no jump scares. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: A serene and contemplative orchestral piece with a distinct East Asian influence, featuring plucked strings, woodwinds, and a full string section. It gradually builds in intensity and emotional depth, transitioning from a calm opening to a more dramatic and cinematic soundscape.
description.zh: 一首宁静而沉思的管弦乐作品，带有独特的东亚风情，以弹拨弦乐、木管乐器和完整的弦乐部分为特色。它逐渐增强强度和情感深度，从平静的开场过渡到更具戏剧性和电影感的音景。
